summary: This component renders a floating chat bubble that opens a panel containing an "Ask my blog" search interface. It shows a helpful hint animation on first visit, manages keyboard interactions like Escape to close and Tab to cycle focus within the panel, and integrates with the existing search system so the expensive question corpus only loads when the user actually opens it.

explanations.73: This query selector finds all focusable elements inside the panel — buttons, links, inputs, and elements with custom tabindex values.
explanations.74: The selector excludes elements with tabindex="-1" because those are intentionally removed from keyboard navigation.
explanations.79: If the user is Shift+Tabbing (going backwards) and they're already on the first focusable element, we wrap them to the last element instead.
explanations.82: If the user is Tab-ing (going forwards) and they're on the last focusable element, we wrap them to the first element.
